_readme: Programs the beta test may touch. kaltstellen freezes or stops nothing that is not listed here.
Copied to beta-test.json by 'beta-test.ps1 setup'; edit that copy, not this file.
Each program: exe = executable name as in Task Manager, Details (required).
path = full path, lets the script start the program itself (optional).
args = arguments for that start (optional); {heartbeat} becomes a file the program writes (test fixtures only).
disposable = true: the script may kill what it started of it (test fixtures only; leave it out for real programs).
suspend: programs that may be frozen (at least one; begin with programs that are not critical).
stop: programs that may be closed and started again; on_timeout 'keep' (default here) leaves one with unsaved work running.

trigger: "builtin" (default) is a renamed copy of ping.exe in the test folder that the script starts and ends; or a program of your own you can start and end at will (exe, path). It switches the profile 'beta-trigger' automatically. Not in suspend or stop.
large: a program with a lot of memory for the trim measurement T19 (may also be in suspend).
elevated: a program you start as administrator for T18 (optional, null to skip).
tray_program: a program with a notification-area icon that is in no profile, for T22 (optional).
Replace every <...> placeholder; setup refuses the file while one is left.
